limits: Structural checks do not prove mathematics, anonymous eligibility, or empirical validity. Visually inspect after edits.
visual_review: Final page 1 inspected; pages 2-12 render-identical to the preceding verified PDF.

ecosystem_inventory.method: Count scanner format-to-ecosystem mappings; confirm exact format-set equality with manifest.Formats. Reader/writer coverage is source inventory, not new experimental validation.

integration_scope: Built-in readers; configured text replacement and commands extend other formats. Reusing CI assumes existing tools, credentials and runners; new provisioning may still need CI changes.
distributed_scope: CCME section 28 explicitly specifies an optional unimplemented execution profile; workers receive resolved release configuration. No multi-machine execution or performance result claimed.
retained_limits: External-effect reconciliation and safe repetition remain in the unchanged body; guarantees in the abstract remain conditional and concern recorded releases.
